svg.title: Workflow: Dealer assist & navigation
svg.desc: Solution workflow (conversational) for Dealer assist & navigation: 1 trigger: Dealer opens the support chat in the DMS → greeting and main menu; 2 user: Taps one of 5 entry buttons → use case chosen; 3 workflow: Shows 1-2 sub-menus of error, reason or option buttons (max 3 taps) → scenario identified; 4 decision: Issue listed? yes → step 5 / no → step 5 with the Others path (open describe-your-issue mode); 5 workflow: Talk-to-agent node passes context: use case, scenario, path, start turn, already-answered list → agent invoked; 6 guardrail: Dealer and branch IDs come from the DMS session and are never asked; no re-asking of menu answers → clean first turn; 7 agent: Sends the first scripted instruction or data request, then runs the procedure sheet from the set turn → resolution steps or collected details; 8 decision: Resolved by the instructions? yes → step 9 / no → agent continues the sheet or hands the details to support; 9 agent: Closes with outcome, reason and a 1-5 star rating → closing record; 10 outcome: Dealer reaches the right procedure in at most 3 taps without repeated questions → faster self-service
svg.text: sheet or hands the details to
